scope: Static review before running input entrypoints; all tests inspected for imports and side-effect APIs, relevant local helper import/main guards examined. Not a comprehensive security audit of every line.
findings: npm scripts have no install hooks, dependencies, or package mutations; no npm install required.
check only spawns current Node with --check for top-level src/scripts JavaScript.
simulate imports local game modules and performs in-memory states and serialized round trips; stdout is redirected to scratch.
verify-test-cases.py executes each existing test module in its own Node process; logs/summary use explicit scratch output.
Tests read local fixtures and sources; app integration uses in-memory Map storage and VM document stubs. There are no filesystem write operations in tests.
Imported helper CLI entrypoints are main-guarded; launcher import reads package version and does not launch a server or browser.
HTTP smoke starts one localhost server using a supplied dedicated port, verifies only shipping paths, writes to the explicit scratch path, kills its own child in finally.
Server binds 127.0.0.1 and serves only shipping allowlisted files. Default sandbox listen may fail with EPERM; an isolated localhost-only escalation is needed for actual HTTP verification.
